source.license_note: Real upstream nats PR #7735; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: A JetStream stream create request containing a null entry in its sources array crashes the server instead of returning a validation error.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the server package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: checkStreamCfg dereferences a nil *StreamSource entry in cfg.Sources when calling isValidName(src.Name), causing a nil pointer panic instead of rejecting the config.

ops_fault.description: A crafted JetStream stream create request with a null element in the sources array crashes the server with a nil pointer panic.
detection_keywords: request times out after server restart
localization_keywords: missing nil check before dereferencing src
null entry deserialized from sources array
repair_keywords: add src == nil guard before isValidName
return sourced stream name is invalid for null sources
validate source entries are non-nil in checkStreamCfg

visible_context.issue_text: Sending a JetStream stream create request whose sources array contains a null element crashes the server instead of returning a validation error.
error_logs: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
visible_context.notes: Real upstream regression; diagnosis injected as upstream ops context.
